children.value: > Fact From Story: We know economic growth is slowing, Australian unemployment is likely to pick up next year and inflation is likely to fall.
> > Fact From Story: The good news is that all of these three things, the trifecta, is pointing towards the RBA stopping rising interest rates and then potentially moving to cut interest rates.
> > > Fact From Story: This is what the market has priced in today.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Financial markets often react in anticipation of central bank decisions regarding interest rates.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Central banks will often stop raising interest rates if economic growth slows, unemployment increases, and inflation decreases.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If economic growth slows, unemployment increases, and inflation decreases, then the Reserve Bank is more likely to stop rising interest rates and potentially cut them.
